basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old digital nomad currently based in Boise, Idaho. I love exploring different online communities and sharing quirky and fun experiences. My day job involves freelance graphic design, which allows me the flexibility to travel often. I'm single and enjoying the freedom it brings. I usually hop online in the late evenings, primarily to unwind and engage in entertaining and humorous content. I have a keen interest in digital marketplaces like Craigslist, and I enjoy trading in Animal Crossing: New Horizons.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in visual arts and have honed my skills in graphic design through self-teaching and freelance work. My interest in online marketplaces and trading stems from years of buying and selling vintage items and collectibles.
